purpose: Capability-surface inventory (issue #1101) — one source to answer: what exists, what is production-supported, what is experimental, what is incomplete, what proves it, which issue owns it.
maintained_by: hand-curated (NOT bot-generated); validated by scripts/ci/validate_capability_inventory.py in ci-advanced-checks

classification_rules.Core: Production-critical; broken == product broken. Has tests + live callers + deploy evidence.
classification_rules.Supported: Production-ready, optional-but-real users; tests exist; degradation is survivable.
classification_rules.Experimental: Real code + callers, but incomplete contract, behind flags, or acceptance criteria not fully met.
classification_rules.Deferred: Deliberately inactive / awaiting a milestone; owner issue carries the plan.
classification_rules.Deprecated: Scheduled for removal; no new investment; removal issue/plan referenced.
